dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-body toward a sharply defined posterior termination at the peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with minimal undulation; slight symmetrical protrusion at the anterior lateral margins near the pectoral region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; uniform high-intensity pixel distribution across the visible dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of localized, low-contrast circular pits or indentations distributed on the posterior third of the dorsal plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark-pigmented elliptical feature at the anterior apex (blowhole) creates a high-contrast focal point against the white baseline.
